~/bio.md

I build iOS apps that people actually use — from mental health platforms protecting patient data under GDPR, to EU border control systems for freight carriers, to Bluetooth beacon SDKs improving accessibility in public transport. With a Master's in Telecommunications Engineering from UVA and over a decade in Swift and Objective-C, I combine deep technical knowledge with clean architecture, rigorous testing, and a genuine obsession with accessibility and user experience.
